digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Pakistan Foreign Office says country is 'doing its utmost' to bring U.S., Iran back to negotiating. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: पीएम मोदी और पुतिन की तिकड़ी बड़ा खेल करने वाली है। यूक्रेन भारतीय नाविकों की मौत पर बौखलाया है। अमेरिकी मिसाइल हमले में ईरान के जवानों की मौत हुई है।

President Donald Trump vowed to hit back hard at Iran after it attacked U. bases in Jordan on Wednesday, July 30, as the war in West Asia reignited and again drew in Iran's proxies military launches new strikes on Iran. Pakistan Foreign Office says country is 'doing its utmost' to bring U. S., Iran back to negotiating. U. S.

articles.title: Fifteen elephant deaths at Kenya park may be due to cyanide poisoning
articles.summary: Analysis of samples collected from carcasses found traces of toxic chemical compound, says Kenya Wildlife ServiceThe recent deaths of 15 elephants near a park in southern Kenya in the past month were likely caused by the animals ingesting pesticides used on nearby tomato farms, the Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) has said.

articles.title: Japan’s earthquakes: Maps and graphics
articles.summary: A magnitude-6.8 earthquake struck in Japan near Kumamoto in Japan on July 28, one of the more powerful earthquakes this year recorded in the region. Here are graphics explaining the quake’s intensity, regional seismicity and more. Japan’s earthquakes: Maps and graphics.

articles.title: 93-year-old leader’s record absence fuels health speculation
articles.summary: Cameroon’s Paul Biya has not made a statement or been seen since leaving for ‘brief private stay’ at Swiss hotel on 7 JuneA record 53-day absence of the world’s oldest head of state has renewed speculation in his native Cameroon about whether he is dead or alive, even though discussing his health is illegal in the country.

articles.title: Russia Launches Massive Missile And Drone Attack On Ukraine
articles.summary: Russia launched dozens of ballistic and cruise missiles, along with hundreds of drones, at Ukraine in the early hours of July 30 in another large-scale attack. Damage was reported in several cities, including Kyiv and Lviv. Russia Launches Massive Missile And Drone Attack On Ukraine.

articles.title: US Military Says Latest Strikes Target Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps
articles.summary: The US military said it launched dozens of strikes against targets linked to Iran's powerful Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) in response to Iranian attacks on American troops in Jordan after President Donald Trump had vowed to retaliate and "hit them very hard." US Military Says Latest Strikes Target Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps.

articles.title: Kyiv’s clear message to New Delhi: Not a single Ukrainian drone sent to Pakistan
articles.summary: This assertion becomes particularly important, especially in light of reports during Operation Sindoor alleging that Pakistani forces were being supplied with drones originating from Ukraine. This claim has circulated but remained difficult to independently verify Kyiv’s clear message to New Delhi: Not a single Ukrainian drone sent to Pakistan.

articles.title: From Pajero culture to street protests: The struggle for accountability in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir
articles.summary: For decades, the Pakistani state has diplomatically showcased PoK to the world as if it were a separate country, complete with its own constitution, a Prime Minister as chief executive, and a President as constitutional head From Pajero culture to street protests: The struggle for accountability in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.

articles.title: Ballots without a country: a quiet case for pluralism in Myanmar
articles.summary: In a country where geography mirrors diversity and authority remains contested, elections in Myanmar unfold detached from realities on the ground; with key Opposition forces excluded and large swathes of the nation outside effective participation, the exercise underscores how the absence of pluralism and federal accommodation continue to undermine any meaningful democratic transition Ballots without a country: a quiet case for pluralism in Myanmar.

articles.title: Putin's Shifting Rhetoric Now Echoes Criticism He Once Aimed At Kyiv
articles.summary: In 2018, Russian President Vladimir Putin accused Ukraine of using the war in its eastern Donbas region to cover up its alleged economic and social problems. In 2026, Putin has been blaming "external enemies" for Russia's issues, including its growing fuel crisis caused by Ukrainian drone attacks. Putin's Shifting Rhetoric Now Echoes Criticism He Once Aimed At Kyiv.

articles.title: Myanmar’s junta slowly but surely winning its war with ASEAN
articles.summary: The multidimensional crisis that has gripped Myanmar since the military coup on February 1, 2021, has entered a new chapter. one increasingly complex and riddled with contradictions. The move by military chief and coup maker Senior General Min Aung Hlaing to overthrow the civilian government of the National League for Democracy (NLD) did not [] The post Myanmar’s junta slowly but surely winning.

articles.title: Russia Pounds Ukraine With Missiles, Killing At Least Eight, Including Children
articles.summary: A barrage of Russian missile and drone strikes pummeled Ukraine overnight, killing at least eight people and injuring dozens of others as President Zelenskyy returned from the United States, where he said President Trump had agreed to provide Ukraine with licenses for Patriot missiles. Russia Pounds Ukraine With Missiles, Killing At Least Eight, Including Children.

articles.title: Why is the founder of Telegram on Russia’s wanted list
articles.summary: The international wanted notice against Pavel Durov comes after the FSB said that Telegram had failed to remove “numerous channels, chats, and bots” allegedly used by “Ukrainian intelligence agencies and terrorist and extremist organisations” to prepare and coordinate acts of “sabotage and terrorism, mass murder, and cyber fraud” in Russia. Why is the founder of Telegram on Russia’s wanted list.

articles.title: Taiwan’s path to victory is unclear
articles.summary: Like few other countries, Taiwan faces a legitimate existential crisis. Beijing’s position that Taiwan must submit to absorption by the People’s Republic of China, even by force if necessary, is insistent and uncompromising. There is zero doubt this would result in the destruction of Taiwan’s democratic political system and liberal political culture. The Chinese government has already [] The post.

articles.title: Ukraine’s Newest Battlefields: Online Retailers, Gas Stations, Shadow Fleets
articles.summary: Why is Ukraine pounding the warehouses and logistics centers of the company known as Russia’s Amazon? For the same reason it’s trying to drive Russian car owners crazy by forcing them to wait in crazy long lines at fueling stations. Ukraine’s Newest Battlefields: Online Retailers, Gas Stations, Shadow Fleets.

articles.title: Does Iran's Attack On Jordan Mark A Shift In Military Strategy?
articles.summary: In what appeared to be the first time Tehran initiated an attack against US targets since the war in the Persian Gulf began in late February, Iran fired ballistic missiles at American bases in Jordan late on July 28. Does Iran's Attack On Jordan Mark A Shift In Military Strategy?

articles.title: Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo
articles.summary: The UN emergency food agency appealed for immediate funding on Wednesday, warning that deepening hunger is undermining the response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that has now infected more than 3,200 people. Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo.

articles.title: UN warns West Bank settler violence hits ‘all-time high’ as calls grow to end occupation
articles.summary: Violence in the occupied West Bank is worsening as the Israeli Government continues to approve new settlements, while settlers and Israeli security forces have “often” acted together to attack local Palestinian communities, the UN’s human rights office (OHCHR) warned on Wednesday. UN warns West Bank settler violence hits ‘all-time high’ as calls grow to end occupation'. Violence in the occupied West Bank is worsening as the Israeli Government continues to approve new settlements while settlers and Israeli security forces have “often” acted together to attack local Palestinian communities, the UN’s human rights office (OHCHR) warned on Wednesday.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Targets Deep Inside Russia, Wildberries Hit Again
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck targets in several places inside Russia on July 29, including an oil refinery and a logistics center belonging to Russia's largest online retailer, Wildberries, as Kyiv expands its long-range strike campaign to pressure Moscow into peace negotiations. Ukrainian Drones Strike Targets Deep Inside Russia, Wildberries Hit Again.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Warehouse In Russia
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries warehouse in the Ryazan region, Russia, setting the building on fire. Wildberries confirmed the evacuation of the facility, marking another hit in a string of drone attacks on Russian industrial sites. Ukrainian drones struck industrial facilities in Russia's Ryazan region, with videos on social media showing a Wildberries warehouse engulfed in flames. Russia's largest online retailer said it evacuated the facility.

articles.title: Asia’s central banks are quietly writing the rules for AI finance
articles.summary: The global economy is entering a new era in which artificial intelligence is no longer merely a technological innovation but an increasingly influential economic force. Much as the internet transformed commerce and globalization reshaped production networks, AI is beginning to alter how businesses make decisions, how capital is allocated, and how financial systems operate. articles.title: For Central Asian Migrants, Russia's School Rules Are Splitting Families
articles.summary: As the new school year approaches, Central Asian migrant parents face a stark choice: bring their children to Russia and risk them being unable to enroll because of stricter Russian language rules or leave them behind. For Central Asian Migrants, Russia's School Rules Are Splitting Families.

articles.title: Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing

articles.title: US bans humanoid robots from China, citing ‘unacceptable risks’
articles.summary: Move comes as the Trump administration has increasingly sought to keep Chinese technology out of the USThe Federal Communications Commission announced a ban on humanoid robots from China on Tuesday, saying that the technology poses “unacceptable risks” to the country’s national security. The move comes as the Trump administration has increasingly sought to keep Chinese technology out of the US.
